rationale: The neutral evidence supports verified_change as the eventual non-authorizing delivery-path candidate: one canonical owner, bounded source and derived paths, a clean baseline, deterministic propagation and validation, and no prohibited impacts are reported. compact_delivery is not eligible because the fixture does not show a completed Brownfield Review with a stored quick_task decision and context.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement only.
Exactly one canonical owner and one source path are reported.
Two derived paths have deterministic propagation.
Baseline is reported clean and validation deterministic.
All listed prohibited-impact categories are false.
Any broader or ambiguous impact requires fail-closed escalation.
This classification is a benchmark candidate and does not constitute a Mode/Slice Decision or approval.
